Fictional Cedar Packaging makes reusable presentation packaging in a fictional factory.
The fixture office answers business enquiries by email; it does not operate retail stores.

sources.title: Velvet pouch construction
sources.content:
The VEL-01 velvet pouch uses polyester velvet with a cotton drawstring.
For jewelry that scratches easily, a separate soft divider is recommended.

clauses.quote: The VEL-01 velvet pouch uses polyester velvet with a cotton drawstring.
For jewelry that scratches easily, a separate soft divider is recommended.

sources.title: Rigid gift box structure
sources.content:
The BX-02 rigid box uses greyboard and wrapped paper, with a removable paper insert.
The magnetic closure is unsuitable for products that must avoid magnets.

clauses.quote: The BX-02 rigid box uses greyboard and wrapped paper, with a removable paper insert.
The magnetic closure is unsuitable for products that must avoid magnets.

sources.title: Logo methods
sources.content:
Hot foil stamping is supported on smooth paper wraps after artwork review.
Raised embroidery is unsuitable for the VEL-01 thin velvet pouch; a woven label is an alternative.

clauses.quote: Hot foil stamping is supported on smooth paper wraps after artwork review.
Raised embroidery is unsuitable for the VEL-01 thin velvet pouch; a woven label is an alternative.

sources.title: VEL-01 minimum quantity
sources.content:
The standard velvet pouch minimum order is 73 pcs for one size and one print design.
Combining multiple designs does not count toward the same design minimum.

clauses.quote: The standard velvet pouch minimum order is 73 pcs for one size and one print design.
Combining multiple designs does not count toward the same design minimum.

terms.conditions: one size and one design; standard velvet pouch

sources.title: Production timing
sources.content:
Standard velvet pouch production takes 19 working days after the order and artwork are confirmed.
Courier transit time is excluded from this production duration.

clauses.quote: Standard velvet pouch production takes 19 working days after the order and artwork are confirmed.
Courier transit time is excluded from this production duration.

terms.conditions: after order and artwork approval; excludes transit

sources.title: Sampling arrangements
sources.content:
Existing stock samples can be requested for checking the standard velvet pouch construction.
Custom artwork samples require separate confirmation; courier charges are not included.

clauses.quote: Existing stock samples can be requested for checking the standard velvet pouch construction.
Custom artwork samples require separate confirmation; courier charges are not included.

terms.value: Existing stock samples available; custom samples require separate confirmation

sources.title: Payment boundary
sources.content:
For confirmed standard paper-box orders, the fixture payment rule is a 30 percent deposit and 70 percent before dispatch.
This payment split does not apply to samples or unconfirmed custom jobs.

clauses.quote: For confirmed standard paper-box orders, the fixture payment rule is a 30 percent deposit and 70 percent before dispatch.
This payment split does not apply to samples or unconfirmed custom jobs.

terms.value: 30 percent deposit and 70 percent before dispatch
terms.conditions: confirmed standard paper-box orders only; not samples or unconfirmed custom jobs

sources.title: Transport responsibility
sources.content:
运输方式应在确认目的地、货量和包装尺寸后选择。
运费需单独核价，本资料不提供固定运费，也不承诺包税。

clauses.quote: 运输方式应在确认目的地、货量和包装尺寸后选择。
运费需单独核价，本资料不提供固定运费，也不承诺包税。

IH-40 标准健身架同一涂层颜色起订量为 12 台。
该数量不适用于特殊结构定制，也不适用于包装项目。
